title: Who he played with when times got tough
summary: The interviewer rephrases the Depression question as 'when times got tough'.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Ask him who he was playing with when depression came.
Who was he playing with when depression came on? When the what? Depression, depression. Depression. Depression. Depression. So who was you playing with when depression came? Depression, you say?
Depression? No, when times got tough. Huh? Tell him when times got tough, you know.
